system.description: This hearthstone looks like an irregular lump of unpolished, dark-yellow amber. It transmutes anything eaten or drunk by the bearer into safe and nourishing food. Nothing the bearer ingests can cause her any harm, even if it is poisoned with the deadliest alchemical venom. The bearer finds a diet of seawater, Yozi venom and fragments of driftwood to be as safe and nourishing as the finest meals served to princes and kings.
